To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a new algorithm for de novo prediction of all-atom structures of transmembrane beta-barrel proteins from protein sequence alignments, and that this algorithm can predict structures with an accuracy sufficient for the generation and analysis of all-atom models.

we developed a method to predict the 2D topology and 3D structure (all-atom models) of transmembrane (TM) β-barrel proteins, and we tested the method on 19 TM β-barrel proteins of known structure, and found that the predicted 2D topology is correct for all of them, and that the predicted 3D structures have an accuracy of ∅0.54 in the TM barrel region, and ∅0.35 in the non-bar

we have developed a new method for predicting the structure of TMB proteins that combines a maximum-entropy evolutionary-coupling method (EVfold) for predicting residue contacts with a machine-learning method (boctopus) to predict the β-strands of the barrel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods to predict the 2D topology and 3D structures of membrane proteins from sequence data alone.
the development and application of computational methods for predicting the structure of transmembrane beta-barrel proteins from sequence alignments.
the development of computational methods to predict the three-dimensional structures of proteins and other biomolecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method has the potential for accurate prediction of the structure of β-barrels, but that the prediction accuracy is dependent on the availability of sufficient sequence information.
the EVfold_bb method is the best method for de novo structure prediction of trans-membrane β-barrel proteins.

the accuracy of EVfold_bb is comparable with that of the best existing approaches to TMB 3D structure modeling, but the method can be applied to more diverse families and is more likely to be able to predict the correct topology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an all-atom 2D and 3D structure-prediction method for large transmembrane proteins.

we have developed a method to predict all-atom 2D and 3D models for large TMB proteins from sequences alone, which will enable research into the function, evolution, and druggability (drugability) of these proteins.
the method EVfold_bb predicts the 3D models with the highest accuracy of all methods that have been developed so far.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, with sufficient sequence information, the 3D structures of TMBs can be predicted accurately from sequence alone, and that this will enable biological research and drug design for these important classes of proteins.
, for TMBs, the combination of EVfold and boctopus2 can generate accurate 3D models from sequences alone.
TMB structures can now be predicted from sequences alone, with accuracy that enables detailed biological studies.
